reviews.text: Lovely staff we seen the vet and had nails cut so didn’t get groomed

Been using here for over 8 years and have had multiple appointments cancelled at the last minute. I've now gone elsewhere and the 1st thing they noticed is that her 5th nail has not been trimmed for a long time.
Was thinking of returning but not now.

⭐☆☆☆☆

Extremely disappointing experience.

My dog, Bella, had a grooming appointment booked for 4:30pm. I always book her next appointment before leaving her previous groom, so I had every reason to believe this booking was confirmed.

I noticed I hadn’t received my usual reminder messages, but later received an automated message saying Bella was due for her groom, so I assumed everything was in order. Before travelling, I even replied to the message and tried calling the store and left a voicemail as nobody answered.

When I arrived, The Groom Room was closed. A member of staff in the Pets at Home store told me that the groomer had handed in her notice and that all appointments should have been cancelled.

My question is: if the appointments should have been cancelled, why wasn’t I told?

A simple phone call, text or email would have prevented me from making a completely unnecessary journey with my dog in this heat! Instead, I wasted my time and travel because of a complete lack of communication.

I understand that staff leave and unexpected situations arise, customers should be informed!

Awful.

I have been going here for a good while, they cancelled my appointment for April, then booked him in for 30th July just received a text message saying they are cancelling again.
I have waited patiently for this appointment in all at least 5 cancelled appointments.
I always had a full groom . Yorkshire terrier.
Joke !!!

Worst customer service. They canceled on me twice in a row, last time canceling same day as the appointment and always offering to reschedule for a month later. Without even being apologetic or trying to provide better solutions. Would not recommend especially when you wait months for the appointment only for it to be canceled. A joke.

They cancelled our appointment "due to unforeseen circumstances" with 3 weeks to go via text message with no appointment rescheduled. This was months ago. Still awaiting refund for our deposit.
Website is poor. Telephone lines rarely answered. The time we have spent trying to get in touch to have our deposit returned is ridiculous.
Would avoid and give my money and loved pet to a respectable independent groomers.

Booked on the 27th Jan, long wait to the 13th but heard good things, received a confirmation email correctly, this was cancelled on the 9th of February for lack of staff, we did not receive an email of which we know was correct, and the number they had was wrong so the text explaining this was not received

Even the cancellation on the 9th would have been dissapointing to wait two weeks when our dog could have been groomed elsewhere and has had to wait

If staff leave surely a notice period should cover scenarios like this

I took my dachshund, Prince, to The Groom Room Selly Oak for their Valentine’s spa, and he absolutely loved it! When I picked him up, he was so happy, wagging his tail, smelling amazing, and his fur was beautiful and silky again.

Meg and Angel did a fantastic job. They communicated everything so clearly and took such great care of him. When I arrived, they already had three dogs there, and I was so impressed with how well they multitasked while still giving me and Prince their full attention. They were both so bubbly, polite, and professional.

I’ll definitely be going back! I also thought it was adorable that Prince’s photo will be going on their Valentine’s wall later today. As someone who loves keepsakes and memories, I think that’s such a lovely touch.

Thank you so much, Meg and Angel — you were both amazing!

Booked grooming for my puppy. Worst ever. Firstly it’s too expensive and then they charge extra for clearing out the mats. And eventually they turn up and say we couldn’t clip out all the mats because we are not happy to do so, book an appointment with the vet to get it done and that’s additional 70quid. Honestly for a little Pomeranian?? And when you charged me extra then why did you not do it?? Disappointed. Taking money and scamming people. Very unpleasant experience!

The Groom Room in Selly Oak is an amazing place to get your dog! They are all so kind, gentle and caring with the dogs, and Daisy always comes out looking fabulous! For me, it's really reassuring that they do everything behind glass so you know they are literally being completely transparent about what they do. Always delighted with the results!

Absolutely disappointed!
Our fluffy cute puppy turn to a monkey face 🐵. I can’t wait hair face hair grow. We mentioned to them we don’t want too much cut on her face and we want her …

I can't fault their grooming, my dogs always look and smell lovely but their phone service is abysmal.  I have been trying to call for the last 3 days leaving several messages for no one to answer the phone or call back so missed appointment and can't even rearrange 😤 …
My dog (Staffordshire bull terrier) had her nails clipped for the first time, my dog was nervous, the lady sat on the floor with the dog, till she had calmed down, …
